trainy:running.name: Running
trainy:running.description: Steady running for cardiovascular fitness and aerobic endurance.
instructions: Start at an easy pace with a stable posture.
Finish with a few easy minutes.

trainy:walking.name: Walking
trainy:walking.description: Low-impact endurance activity at a brisk or relaxed walking pace.
instructions: Choose a pace you can sustain with good form.
Stay upright and roll through each step.
Adjust distance and duration to your goal.

trainy:cycling.name: Cycling
trainy:cycling.description: Endurance training on a bicycle or indoor bike.
instructions: Adjust the saddle and resistance before starting.
Lower the resistance for a short cool-down.

trainy:swimming.name: Swimming
instructions: Warm up with a few easy lengths.

trainy:interval_running.name: Interval running
trainy:interval_running.description: Running session alternating work and recovery intervals.
instructions: Warm up before the first interval.
Follow the planned work and recovery durations.

trainy:mobility_session.name: Mobility session
trainy:mobility_session.description: Guided or free session for maintaining comfortable range of motion.
instructions: Move slowly within a controllable range.
